expectations.text: The endpoint is defined with MapPost in Program.cs and uses a request DTO rather than binding Item directly
expectations.evidence: The Edit to Program.cs added app.MapPost("/api/items", ... CreateItemRequest request, ItemStore store ...). CreateItemRequest is a new sealed record DTO with Name and Price, so Item is not bound directly.

expectations.text: Invalid requests are rejected with a 400 validation problem response
expectations.evidence: The handler returns TypedResults.ValidationProblem(errors) when Name is blank or Price <= 0. A live curl with {"name":"","price":0} returned HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request with a validation problem body listing both errors.

expectations.text: Produces/ProducesValidationProblem (or equivalent typed results) metadata is added for OpenAPI
expectations.evidence: The endpoint chains .Produces<Item>(StatusCodes.Status201Created) and .ProducesValidationProblem(). It also declares the return type Results<Created<Item>, ValidationProblem> and uses TypedResults.

expectations.text: A successful request returns 201 Created with a Location header pointing at the GET endpoint
expectations.evidence: The handler returns TypedResults.Created($"/api/items/{item.Id}", item). A live curl with a valid body returned HTTP/1.1 201 Created with Location: /api/items/1, which matches the GET route /api/items/{id:int}.
